quests.instruction: SLIDE OR TAP TO MATCH THE TARGET VOWEL SOUND
quests.hint: Think of how you say 'calm'. The vowel in 'father' should feel the same way. That is the PALM sound, not the TRAP sound in 'cat'.
quests.explanation: 'father' is built on the PALM vowel /ɑː/: a long, open-back vowel - the mouth drops wide open with unrounded lips. Keep this anchored against 'calm' so you can recognise it in new words too.
quests.vowelTensionRule: /æ/ (TRAP) is made with the tongue low and forward and the mouth spread wide. /ɑː/ (PALM) pulls the tongue back and keeps the jaw dropped, with the sound held longer.
